WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

An experienced PHP Laravel Developer to work on an application that allows you to benefit from psychological help. It offers online access to therapists – individual, couples and child therapy. The app is sold as a benefit for companies, but you can also use it individually.

Tech stack:

  • PHP 7 & 8
  • Laravel (Laravel Nova – nice to have)
  • Docker
  • follow SOLID, KISS, DRY rules
  • GIT
  • REST API
  • Working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English
